name: true402
description: Pay-per-call AI + web + on-chain tools for agents over x402 (USDC on Base). No accounts, no API keys — the wallet is the identity. 12 tools incl. token rug/honeypot safety.

wallet_private_key.title: Wallet private key

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: true402 API base. Override to point at a self-hosted instance.
